_note: Items from docs/puzzle-bible.md. Exactly one of room/inside per item. Keys have 'opens'. Hidden items start inside a container.

items.name: workbench
items.description: A scarred wooden workbench. A coffee can of pencils, a cassette, and a Walkman sit on it.

items.name: coffee can
items.description: A coffee can stuffed with sharpened pencils.

items.name: pencil
items.description: A yellow number 2 pencil, chewed at one end. Every kid in the 80s knew what else it was for.

items.name: cassette
items.description: A cassette.

states.tangled: A cassette with its tape pulled out in a brown, shiny tangle.
states.rewound: A cassette with its tape neatly rewound.
states.loaded: The cassette is loaded in the Walkman.

items.name: Walkman
items.description: A chunky portable cassette player with a headphone jack and a battery door.

items.name: battery jar
items.description: A jar of mismatched batteries. Exactly one pair still has some life in it.
items.decoyLine: A jar of dead batteries and one living pair. Thrilling.

items.name: Atari console
items.description: A wood-paneled Atari console, hooked to a small TV. The paneling is the best part.

items.name: small TV
items.description: A small TV with rabbit ears. It shows snow.

items.name: cartridge box
items.description: A cartridge box. In kid handwriting on the label: DO NOT LOSE. MOM WILL KILL ME. There is a foam insert inside.

items.name: Atari catalog
items.description: A faded Atari catalog with a folded corner.

items.name: joystick
items.description: A joystick with a rubber band wrapped around its base.

items.name: Simon
items.description: A Simon game with four colored panels.
items.decoyLine: Four colors and a sense of betrayal. No key.

items.name: Magic 8-Ball
items.description: A Magic 8-Ball.
items.decoyLine: Ask again later. Thrilling.

items.name: baseball cards
items.description: A shoebox of baseball cards.
items.decoyLine: Mint condition, probably worth less than the box.

items.name: View-Master
items.description: A View-Master with a reel of cartoon landscapes.
items.decoyLine: Three-dimensional disappointment.

items.name: foam insert
items.description: A slab of gray packing foam that cradles the cartridge. One corner looks like it has been lifted before.

items.name: hallway key
items.description: A small brass key tagged HALLWAY in a child's handwriting.

items.name: phone table
items.description: A narrow table holding a rotary phone and an answering machine.

items.name: rotary phone
items.description: A heavy rotary phone. Ten finger holes and a metal stop. It is begging to be dialed.

items.name: answering machine
items.description: An answering machine with a blinking red light.

items.name: pager
items.description: Grandpa's work pager. The screen shows 555-0142. A beeper is for when people needed to find you but did not want to hear your voice.

items.name: scrap of paper
items.description: A scrap of paper by the phone: TELL MOM: NOT MY JACKET.

items.name: snapshot
items.description: A snapshot of young Dad in a jacket with the collar popped. He looks very pleased with himself.

items.name: coat closet
items.description: The coat closet is slightly ajar. A jacket sleeve is showing.

items.name: lucky jacket
items.description: A satin jacket with a popped collar. It has an outer pocket and a zippered inside pocket.

items.name: outer pocket
items.description: The jacket's outer pocket. The usual place for loose change and lint.

items.name: inside pocket
items.description: A zippered pocket sewn into the lining of the jacket, where a good jacket keeps a secret plan.

items.name: emergency quarter
items.description: A quarter. Always keep an emergency quarter.

items.name: bedroom key
items.description: A silver key on a loop of yarn, tagged BEDROOM.

items.name: bowl of keys
items.description: A bowl of seven keys, each labeled in Grandma's handwriting. None of them fit anything you can see.
items.decoyLine: Nobody ever labeled the right one.

items.name: Yellow Pages
items.description: A fat Yellow Pages.
items.decoyLine: Too heavy to be useful and too light to throw.

items.name: Rolodex
items.description: A Rolodex stuffed with cards.
items.decoyLine: Six hundred names. None of them answer.

items.name: umbrella stand
items.description: An umbrella stand holding two umbrellas and a cane.
items.decoyLine: No key. No dignity.

items.name: wall calendar
items.description: A wall calendar stuck on a month in 1987.
items.decoyLine: Time stopped. Very dramatic.

items.name: NES
items.description: A gray NES with one controller. Its cartridge slot is empty.

items.name: cartridge
items.description: A well-loved football game cartridge, its contacts a little dusty.

items.name: toybox
items.description: A toybox with a hand-lettered lid: AUTOBOTS ONLY. DECEPTICONS KEEP OUT.

items.name: Polaroid
items.description: A Polaroid of young Dad holding a big robot trailer like a trophy.

items.name: comic
items.description: A comic book with a sticker sheet tucked inside. The robot hero stands guard on the cover.

items.name: robot trailer
items.description: A toy trailer that looks like it unfolds. It has a small compartment.

states.folded: A toy trailer, folded up tight. It looks like it unfolds. Somewhere in it is a small compartment.
states.unfolded: The trailer has unfolded into a tiny command platform. A small compartment is set into the base.

items.name: Cabbage Patch Kid
items.description: A Cabbage Patch Kid with an adoption certificate.
items.decoyLine: Adopted. No key in the paperwork.

items.name: Rubik's Cube
items.description: A Rubik's Cube, scrambled.
items.decoyLine: Unsolved since 1983.

items.name: Etch A Sketch
items.description: An Etch A Sketch with a stick figure on it.
items.decoyLine: A drawing of a stick figure. Hang it in the Louvre.

items.name: action figure
items.description: An action figure missing an arm.
items.decoyLine: He's lost more than a key.

items.name: villain robot
items.description: A villain robot toy with a scowl molded into its face.
items.decoyLine: Hostile. Probably holding a grudge.

items.name: study key
items.description: A bronze key taped inside a compartment, tagged STUDY.

items.name: hi-fi console
items.description: A wooden hi-fi console with a turntable on top.

items.name: turntable
items.description: A turntable with a record on the platter. Its cord is not plugged in.

items.name: record
items.description: A homemade novelty disc with a handwritten label.

items.name: bookshelf
items.description: A tall bookshelf pushed against the wall behind the console. Something dangles behind it.

items.name: power cord
items.description: The turntable's power cord, dangling behind the bookshelf.

items.name: Commodore 64
items.description: A beige Commodore 64 with a monitor.

items.name: disk box
items.description: A 5.25-inch floppy disk box with a hinged lid.

items.name: sticky note
items.description: A sticky note on the monitor in Grandpa's handwriting: DO NOT TOUCH MY DISKS.

items.name: newspaper clipping
items.description: A clipping about the backwards-messages scare. One paragraph is circled. In the margin: DAVID. NO.

items.name: typewriter
items.description: A heavy manual typewriter.
items.decoyLine: A keyboard that fights back. No key.

items.name: stack of vinyl
items.description: A tall stack of vinyl records.
items.decoyLine: Every one of them is a snooze.

items.name: desk lamp
items.description: A bendy desk lamp.
items.decoyLine: Illuminating, but not useful.

items.name: globe
items.description: A globe showing countries that have since changed names.
items.decoyLine: Geopolitics is out of date. So is this.

items.name: letter opener
items.description: A brass letter opener.
items.decoyLine: Opens letters. Sadly not mysteries.

items.name: grandparents' key
items.description: A key taped inside the disk box lid, tagged GRANDPARENTS.

items.name: VCR
items.description: A VCR under the TV, blinking 12:00.

items.name: TV
items.description: A boxy TV with a dial for channels.

items.name: clock radio
items.description: A clock radio on the nightstand, stopped at an odd time. It has a battery cover on the back.

items.name: nightstand
items.description: A nightstand with a drawer. Inside is a scribbled TV listing.

items.name: TV listing
items.description: A scribbled TV listing with SATURDAY circled twice.

items.name: aerobics tape case
items.description: An aerobics workout tape case. It looks like it holds exactly one thing: leg-warmer energy.
items.decoyLine: Dad's mom exercised. Dad's mom was weirdly fit. No key.

items.name: home video tape
items.description: A tape with a handwritten label: DAD'S CHRISTMAS 1986.

items.name: Betamax tape
items.description: A Betamax tape. Wrong shape for the VCR.
items.decoyLine: Wrong format. Wrong era. Wrong decade, honestly.

items.name: jewelry box
items.description: A jewelry box with a tiny ballerina.
items.decoyLine: Ballerina is judging you.

items.name: leg warmers
items.description: A pair of bright leg warmers.
items.decoyLine: No pockets and no shame.

items.name: tie rack
items.description: A tie rack with eleven ties.
items.decoyLine: Eleven ties. None of them taste.

items.name: front door key
items.description: A worn house key.
